name: ListPlaylist

parameters.description_en: The ID of the playlist. If you specify this parameter, only the information about the specified playlist is returned. If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all playlists that belong to your account is returned. Use the ProgramId value returned by the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh:
节目单ID。如果填此参数，则返回该节目单信息。若不填，默认返回该用户所有节目单信息。
如果您通过[AddPlaylistItems接口](~~2848078~~)添加节目单项，请查看AddPlaylistItems接口调用返回的参数ProgramId值。
